takeaways.en: Get data offers hundreds of connectors: files, databases, cloud services, SharePoint, Dataverse and existing semantic models.
takeaways.zh: 「获取数据」提供数百个连接器：文件、数据库、云服务、SharePoint、Dataverse 以及现有的语义模型。

takeaways.en: Connect to a SharePoint or OneDrive file by its web URL, not a local sync path, so the service can refresh it without a gateway.
takeaways.zh: SharePoint 或 OneDrive 中的文件要用网址连接，而不是本机同步路径，这样服务就能直接刷新，不需要网关。

takeaways.en: The Folder and SharePoint folder connectors combine many files with the same layout into one table.
takeaways.zh: 「文件夹」和「SharePoint 文件夹」连接器能把很多格式相同的文件合并成一张表。

html.en: Everything starts with Get data in Power BI Desktop. Each connector knows how to talk to one kind of source and shows you a Navigator where you pick tables, then either Load them straight into the model or Transform data in the Power Query Editor first.
html.zh: 一切从 Power BI Desktop 的获取数据开始。每个连接器负责一种数据源，并显示导航器让你选择表，然后可以直接加载到模型，或者先在 Power Query 编辑器中转换数据。

rows.en: Files
rows.zh: 文件

rows.en: Excel, CSV/text, XML, JSON, PDF, Parquet
rows.zh: Excel、CSV/文本、XML、JSON、PDF、Parquet

rows.en: A local path (C:\…) needs a gateway to refresh in the service.
rows.zh: 本机路径（C:\…）在服务中刷新需要网关。

rows.en: Folders
rows.zh: 文件夹

rows.en: Folder, SharePoint folder
rows.zh: 文件夹、SharePoint 文件夹

rows.en: All files must share the same columns; Combine uses a sample file.
rows.zh: 所有文件的列必须相同；「合并」会以一个示例文件为准。

rows.en: Databases
rows.zh: 数据库

rows.en: SQL Server, Azure SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL
rows.zh: SQL Server、Azure SQL、Oracle、PostgreSQL、MySQL

rows.en: Can use Import or DirectQuery; on-premises servers need a gateway.
rows.zh: 可用导入或 DirectQuery；本地服务器需要网关。

rows.en: Cloud services
rows.zh: 云服务

rows.en: Dataverse, Salesforce, Google Analytics, SharePoint Online lists
rows.zh: Dataverse、Salesforce、Google Analytics、SharePoint Online 列表

rows.en: Sign-in (OAuth) credentials expire and must be renewed in the service.
rows.zh: 登录（OAuth）凭据会过期，需要在服务中更新。

rows.en: Fabric / Power BI
rows.zh: Fabric / Power BI

rows.en: Power BI semantic models, lakehouse, warehouse, dataflows
rows.zh: Power BI 语义模型、湖仓、仓库、数据流

rows.en: Reusing a shared model avoids duplicate logic.
rows.zh: 重用共享模型可以避免重复的逻辑。

html.en: Point the Folder connector at a folder of monthly CSV files and choose Combine & Transform. Power Query creates a helper query with a sample file and a function, applies your steps from the sample to every file, and appends the results. New files dropped into the folder are picked up at the next refresh.
html.zh: 把「文件夹」连接器指向存放每月 CSV 的文件夹，选择合并并转换。Power Query 会建立带示例文件的辅助查询和一个函数，把示例上的步骤套用到每个文件，再把结果追加起来。之后放进文件夹的新文件，下次刷新时会自动纳入。

html.en: If a scenario says files are stored in SharePoint Online and the report must refresh in the service without a gateway, the answer is the SharePoint folder (or Web) connector with the site URL — not the local OneDrive sync folder.
html.zh: 如果题目说文件存放在 SharePoint Online，且报表要在服务中刷新又不用网关，答案是用「SharePoint 文件夹」（或 Web）连接器配合站点网址——而不是本机 OneDrive 同步文件夹。

q.en: Sales files arrive every month as CSVs with identical columns in one SharePoint Online folder. You want one table that grows automatically. What do you use?
q.zh: 每个月都有列完全相同的销售 CSV 放进同一个 SharePoint Online 文件夹。你想要一张会自动增长的表，该用什么？

why.en: Enter data is for small manual tables.
why.zh: 「输入数据」只适合少量手动输入的表。

html.zh: 每个文件用一次「文本/CSV」连接器

why.en: You would have to add a query for every new month.
why.zh: 每个新月份都得手动加一个查询。

html.zh: SharePoint 文件夹连接器，然后「合并」

why.en: Right: new files are included at each refresh, and no gateway is needed.
why.zh: 对：每次刷新都会纳入新文件，也不需要网关。

html.en: Folder connector on the local OneDrive sync path
html.zh: 对本机 OneDrive 同步路径使用「文件夹」连接器

why.en: A local path needs a gateway to refresh in the service.
why.zh: 本机路径在服务中刷新需要网关。

heading.en: Import, DirectQuery, Dual and Direct Lake

takeaways.en: Import copies the data into the model: fastest queries and full features, but it is only as fresh as the last refresh.
takeaways.zh: 导入会把数据复制到模型：查询最快、功能完整，但数据只和上次刷新时一样新。

takeaways.en: DirectQuery leaves the data in the source and queries it live: always current, but slower and with some limits.
takeaways.zh: DirectQuery 把数据留在源中、实时查询：数据始终最新，但较慢，也有一些限制。

takeaways.en: Dual tables act as Import or DirectQuery as needed; Direct Lake reads Delta tables in Fabric OneLake directly.
takeaways.zh: 双重（Dual）表按需要充当导入或 DirectQuery；Direct Lake 直接读取 Fabric OneLake 中的 Delta 表。

html.en: Each table in a model has a storage mode. Choosing it is a trade-off between speed, freshness, size and features — and the exam asks about this trade-off often.
html.zh: 模型中的每张表都有一个存储模式。选哪一个是在速度、数据新鲜度、大小和功能之间取舍——考试经常考这一点。

rows.en: Import
rows.zh: 导入

rows.en: Compressed in the model (VertiPaq engine)
rows.zh: 压缩存放在模型中（VertiPaq 引擎）

rows.en: Fastest; all DAX and Power Query features; works offline in Desktop
rows.zh: 最快；支持所有 DAX 和 Power Query 功能；Desktop 中可离线使用

rows.en: Needs refresh; model size limits (1 GB per model with Pro)
rows.zh: 需要刷新；模型大小有限制（Pro 每个模型 1 GB）

rows.en: DirectQuery
rows.zh: DirectQuery

rows.en: Stays in the source; queries sent at view time
rows.zh: 留在数据源中；查看时发送查询

rows.en: Near real-time data; very large sources; source security
rows.zh: 接近实时；适合超大数据源；可沿用源端安全性

rows.en: Slower; load on the source; some DAX/M limits; 1 million rows per intermediate result
rows.zh: 较慢；增加源端负载；部分 DAX/M 受限；中间结果上限 100 万行

rows.en: Dual
rows.zh: 双重

rows.en: Both: cached and queryable live
rows.zh: 两者皆有：既缓存也可实时查询

rows.en: Dimension tables in composite models avoid slow cross-source joins
rows.zh: 组合模型中的维度表可避免缓慢的跨源联接

rows.en: Only meaningful in composite models
rows.zh: 只在组合模型中有意义

rows.en: Direct Lake
rows.zh: Direct Lake

rows.en: Delta tables in Fabric OneLake
rows.zh: Fabric OneLake 中的 Delta 表

rows.en: Import-like speed without copying and refreshing data
rows.zh: 接近导入的速度，却不用复制和刷新数据

rows.en: Only for Fabric lakehouse/warehouse data; can fall back to DirectQuery
rows.zh: 只适用于 Fabric 湖仓/仓库的数据；可能回退为 DirectQuery

html.en: A composite model mixes storage modes, for example a huge fact table in DirectQuery with small dimension tables set to Dual. A filter from a Dual dimension can then be answered from the cache or pushed to the source together with the fact table.
html.zh: 组合模型混合使用多种存储模式，例如超大的事实表用 DirectQuery，小的维度表设为双重。这样来自双重维度表的筛选，既可以用缓存回答，也可以和事实表一起推送到数据源。

items.en: Choose Import by default — it is the fastest and most flexible.
items.zh: 默认选导入——最快、最灵活。

items.en: Choose DirectQuery when data must be near real-time, is too large to import, or must stay in the source for compliance.
items.zh: 当数据必须接近实时、太大无法导入，或因合规要求必须留在数据源时，选 DirectQuery。

items.en: Choose Direct Lake when the data already sits as Delta tables in a Fabric lakehouse or warehouse.
items.zh: 当数据已是 Fabric 湖仓或仓库中的 Delta 表时，选 Direct Lake。

html.en: Switching a table from DirectQuery to Import is possible; switching from Import to DirectQuery is not — you would rebuild the table.
html.zh: 表可以从 DirectQuery 切换为导入，但不能从导入切换为 DirectQuery——必须重新建立这张表。

q.en: Managers need dashboards that show stock levels within a minute of a change in a 2 TB SQL database. Which storage mode fits?
q.zh: 经理们需要在 2 TB 的 SQL 数据库变动后一分钟内就看到库存水平。哪种存储模式合适？

why.en: A daily refresh is not near real-time, and 2 TB is large to import.
why.zh: 每天刷新不算接近实时，2 TB 也太大不适合导入。

why.en: Right: data stays in the source and each query sees current values.
why.zh: 对：数据留在源中，每次查询都看到最新的值。

html.en: Import with eight refreshes a day

why.en: Still up to three hours old between refreshes.
why.zh: 两次刷新之间仍可能落后三个小时。

why.en: Dual still caches data and needs refresh; it suits dimension tables in a composite model.
why.zh: 双重仍会缓存数据、需要刷新；它适合组合模型中的维度表。

q.en: A composite model has a DirectQuery Sales table and an Import Product table. Slicing Sales by Product is slow. What is the usual fix?
q.zh: 某组合模型中 Sales 表为 DirectQuery，Product 表为导入。按 Product 切片 Sales 很慢。通常怎么解决？

why.en: That may not be possible (size, freshness) and loses the DirectQuery requirement.
why.zh: 可能做不到（大小、实时性），也违背使用 DirectQuery 的需求。

why.en: That changes filter direction, not where queries run.
why.zh: 那只改变筛选方向，不改变查询在哪里执行。

why.en: Right: the dimension can then be sent to the source with the fact table query.
why.zh: 对：这样维度表可以和事实表的查询一起发送到数据源。

html.en: Add a calculated column to Sales

why.en: Calculated columns do not solve cross-source joins.
why.zh: 计算列不能解决跨源联接的问题。

heading.en: Connecting to a shared semantic model

takeaways.en: A live connection to a published Power BI semantic model reuses its tables, measures and security; you build only the report.
takeaways.zh: 对已发布 Power BI 语义模型的实时连接，可重用其表、度量值和安全设置；你只需制作报表。

takeaways.en: With a live connection you cannot use Power Query or change the model, but you can add report-level measures.
takeaways.zh: 使用实时连接时不能使用 Power Query，也不能修改模型，但可以新增报表级度量值。

takeaways.en: To add your own data to a shared model, change it to a composite model (DirectQuery for Power BI semantic models).
takeaways.zh: 如果要把自己的数据加进共享模型，就把它改为组合模型（对 Power BI 语义模型使用 DirectQuery）。

html.en: Large organisations keep one curated, certified semantic model and let many report authors build on it. In Desktop choose Get data → Power BI semantic models (or the OneLake catalog) and pick the model. You need Build permission on it.
html.zh: 大型组织通常维护一个经过整理和认证的语义模型，让许多报表作者在其上制作报表。在 Desktop 中选择获取数据 → Power BI 语义模型（或 OneLake 目录）并选择模型。你需要对它有生成（Build）权限。

rows.en: Live connection
rows.zh: 实时连接

rows.en: Build visuals, add report-level measures. No Power Query, no new tables or relationships. Model security (RLS) still applies.
rows.zh: 制作视觉对象、新增报表级度量值。不能用 Power Query，不能新增表或关系。模型的安全设置（RLS）仍然有效。

rows.en: Composite model (DirectQuery to the semantic model)
rows.zh: 组合模型（对语义模型使用 DirectQuery）

rows.en: Add local tables (for example a budget in Excel), relate them to the remote tables, add calculated columns on local tables.
rows.zh: 可以加入本地表（例如 Excel 中的预算），与远程表建立关系，并在本地表上新增计算列。

html.en: The status bar shows Connected live to the Power BI semantic model. To convert, select Make changes to this model; Power BI adds a local DirectQuery connection so you can extend it.
html.zh: 状态栏会显示已实时连接到 Power BI 语义模型。若要转换，选择对此模型进行更改；Power BI 会加入本地 DirectQuery 连接，让你扩展模型。

html.en: Keywords: "reuse the certified model", "single source of truth", "avoid duplicating measures" point to connecting to the shared semantic model rather than importing the same data again.
html.zh: 关键词：「重用认证模型」「单一事实来源」「避免重复度量值」，都指向连接共享语义模型，而不是再导入一次相同的数据。

q.en: You are live connected to a certified semantic model and need a quick ratio measure for your report only. What can you do?
q.zh: 你已实时连接到认证语义模型，只想在自己的报表里加一个比例度量值。可以怎么做？

why.en: Not possible on a live connection.
why.zh: 实时连接下不能新增计算列。

why.en: Right: report-level measures are allowed on a live connection and do not change the shared model.
why.zh: 对：实时连接允许报表级度量值，而且不会改动共享模型。

html.en: Edit the query in Power Query
html.zh: 在 Power Query 中编辑查询

why.en: Power Query is not available on a live connection.
why.zh: 实时连接下无法使用 Power Query。

why.en: That duplicates data and logic.
why.zh: 这会重复数据和逻辑。

heading.en: Data source settings, privacy levels and parameters
heading.zh: 数据源设置、隐私级别与参数

takeaways.en: Data source settings is where you change a source path or server and edit or clear credentials.
takeaways.zh: 「数据源设置」用来修改数据源路径或服务器，以及编辑或清除凭据。

takeaways.en: Privacy levels (Private, Organizational, Public) stop data from one source leaking to another when queries combine them.
takeaways.zh: 隐私级别（私有、组织、公共）可在查询合并多个数据源时，防止一个来源的数据泄露给另一个来源。

takeaways.en: Parameters make values like a server name or a date reusable and changeable without editing every query.
takeaways.zh: 参数让服务器名称、日期等值可以重用和修改，而不必逐一编辑每个查询。

html.en: In Desktop go to File → Options and settings → Data source settings (or Transform data → Data source settings). Here you can Change Source when a file moves or a server is renamed, and Edit Permissions to update credentials and the privacy level. In the service the same credentials are set in the semantic model's settings.
html.zh: 在 Desktop 中打开文件 → 选项和设置 → 数据源设置（或「转换数据 → 数据源设置」）。文件搬家或服务器改名时可以更改源，用编辑权限更新凭据和隐私级别。在服务中，同样的凭据是在语义模型的设置里设定。

rows.en: Private
rows.zh: 私有

rows.en: Sensitive data; never sent to another source.
rows.zh: 敏感数据；绝不会发送到其他数据源。

rows.en: Organizational
rows.zh: 组织

rows.en: Can be combined with other Organizational sources, not with Public ones.
rows.zh: 可以与其他「组织」来源合并，但不能与「公共」来源合并。

rows.en: Public
rows.zh: 公共

rows.en: Anyone can see it, such as open data on the web.
rows.zh: 任何人都能看到，例如网上的公开数据。

html.en: If you combine sources with conflicting levels, Power Query raises a Formula.Firewall error or evaluates the sources separately, which can stop query folding and slow refresh.
html.zh: 如果合并了隐私级别相冲突的来源，Power Query 会出现 Formula.Firewall 错误，或分开读取各来源，这可能导致查询折叠失效、刷新变慢。

html.en: Manage Parameters → New Parameter creates a named value with a type and, optionally, a list of allowed values. Use it in a source step, a filter or a custom column. After publishing, you can change parameter values in the semantic model settings without opening Desktop.
html.zh: 管理参数 → 新建参数可建立有名称和类型的值，还可以限定允许的值列表。它可用于数据源步骤、筛选或自定义列。发布后，可以在语义模型设置中修改参数值，不必打开 Desktop。

blocks.text:
// Source step that uses a parameter called ServerName
let
    Source = Sql.Database(ServerName, "SalesDW"),
    Sales  = Source{[Schema = "dbo", Item = "FactSales"]}[Data]
in
    Sales

items.en: Switch between development and production servers by changing one parameter.
items.zh: 只改一个参数，就能在开发和正式服务器之间切换。

items.en: Incremental refresh requires two DateTime parameters named exactly RangeStart and RangeEnd.
items.zh: 增量刷新需要两个名称必须是 RangeStart 和 RangeEnd 的日期/时间参数。

items.en: A Power BI template (.pbit) can prompt for parameter values when someone opens it.
items.zh: Power BI 模板（.pbit）在打开时可以提示输入参数值。

q.en: The report must point to a test server while you develop and to production after publishing, without editing queries. What do you create?
q.zh: 开发时报表要连测试服务器，发布后要连正式服务器，而且不想修改查询。应该建立什么？

why.en: Duplicated queries double the maintenance.
why.zh: 复制查询会让维护工作加倍。

html.en: A parameter for the server name, used in the source step
html.zh: 建立服务器名称参数，并在数据源步骤中使用

why.en: Right: change the parameter in Desktop or in the semantic model settings.
why.zh: 对：在 Desktop 或语义模型设置中修改参数即可。

why.en: DAX runs on loaded data; it cannot choose the source.
why.zh: DAX 在载入后的数据上运行，不能选择数据源。

why.en: Privacy levels do not switch servers.
why.zh: 隐私级别不会切换服务器。

q.en: What must the two parameters for incremental refresh be called?
q.zh: 增量刷新所用的两个参数必须叫什么？

html.en: Any names, as long as they are Date type
html.zh: 任何名称，只要是「日期」类型

why.en: The names are fixed and the type is Date/Time, not Date.
why.zh: 名称是固定的，类型是「日期/时间」而不是「日期」。

why.en: Right, and both must be of type Date/Time.
why.zh: 对，而且两者都必须是「日期/时间」类型。
